description: Administrators only: the whole installation by the numbers — accounts, workspaces, projects, issues, comments and sprints, plus issues broken down by status and by project. Counted across every workspace, which is what makes it the installation's rather than one company's. A total is null, never zero, when a machine of the fleet did not answer: 'fleet' says which machines were asked and which are missing, and 'here' is always what this machine counted. The breakdowns are this machine's. Read a null as 'nobody knows', never as 'none'.
name: admin_overview
